component: Month/timed/all-day event list and inherited item accessibility setup

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The three event-list layouts give their ordered lists a listbox role and their normal/drag-shadow li wrappers a presentation role. The actual calendar items call the shared option initializer, carry aria-selected and expose a normalized title or untitled fallback. Their label CSS disables label pointer targeting while the item retains its existing pointer setting. This is a source-level owner/attribute relationship, not a verified listbox keyboard model, native accessible tree or hit-test result; no new direct tests assert it.
title: Calendar event lists use presentation wrappers while items own option names and selection
